title: Backplane audit TF module: CloudTrail -> OpenSearch retention + S3 archival
creator: Maya Patel
description: Create a reusable Terraform module (backplane-audit) to provision and wire together CloudTrail, S3 audit buckets with lifecycle/archive rules, KMS keys, cross-account access for Dedicated/Private deployments, and an OpenSearch ingestion pipeline with ILM-based retention. The module must support: 1) option to deploy a managed OpenSearch domain or stream to a customer-managed domain via Kinesis/Logstash, 2) configurable retention windows for both S3 (hot/cold/glacier) and OpenSearch indices, 3) strict encryption-at-rest (KMS) and in-transit, 4) cross-account bucket delegation for central logging accounts, 5) CloudWatch alarms & synthetic health checks for ingestion/backpressure, and 6) upgrade/rollout hooks to perform zero-downtime policy changes. Deliverables: public interface docs, Terraform module, example VPC overlay, automated acceptance tests, and upgrade playbook.
updates: 2026-02-12: RFC posted to Confluence with proposed module inputs/outputs and polymorphic backends (managed-opensearch | stream-to-remote). Link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/Backplane+Audit+TF+Module

2026-02-18: Spike complete - validated CloudTrail -> S3 + KMS envelope encryption in a dev VPC. Found issue: S3 lifecycle transition to Glacier requires versioned buckets for our retention model; updated module design to enable versioning by default.
2026-02-25: First draft of module landed in monorepo under infra/terraform/modules/backplane-audit. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1876

2026-03-01: Design review with Security and Platform. Security requested explicit KMS key rotation policy and separate keys for access logs vs audit logs. Incorporated as optional inputs (enable_separate_kms_keys). Added acceptance test for encrypted index templates.
2026-03-04: Integration test added to CI (ternary: managed-opensearch path). Tests simulate CloudTrail event bursts to validate batching/ingestion throttling and ILM rollover triggers.

2026-03-08: QA found edge case: cross-account PutObject requires s3:PutObjectAcl for the CloudTrail service principal in certain accounts. Added guidance to example usage and a helper IAM role to reduce operator error.

2026-03-10: PR feedback from infra code owners: prefer using module-level locals to construct bucket policy and reduce interpolation complexity. Pushed follow-up commit to address reviewers' comments: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1876#discussion_r345678

2026-03-12: Rolling acceptance deployment to staging complete. Healthchecks report: ingestion latency within SLO under normal load; alarm thresholds adjusted to include index_age and bytes_written metrics. Planning rollout to Dedicated beta next week.
Follow-ups: finalize upgrade playbook (runbook for policy changes), add Terraform acceptance tests for stream-to-remote path, coordinate security sign-off and KMS rotation automation.
notes: Keep module inputs minimal and opinionated: retention should expose hot_days, warm_days, cold_days and an archival_target (glacier|deep_archive). Provide sensible defaults tuned for 90-day hot + 180-day warm + 365-day cold. The module must not assume OpenSearch is managed in every deployment; support forwarding via Kinesis Firehose with IAM and buffer settings. Include a lightweight healthcheck Lambda (python) that queries CloudWatch metrics and writes status to a central SNS topic for pager integration.
